title: Typing while replies stream
description: One process, launched on the control session, with the app's agent routed to the framework's replay server. Five new threads each get the same prompt, typed untimed; a trusted Enter keydown sends it, and the first word is measured to the first frame in which the reply's first 8 characters are painted. The five sends are 2 s apart, so all five replies stream at once. In a sixth new thread, 60 trusted key presses, 250 ms apart with a seeded 20% jitter, are each measured from the trusted keydown to the first frame, read after style and layout, whose composer text holds every key typed so far; a key not painted within 2 s is a miss.

metrics.description: Trusted Enter keydown to the first frame in which the reply's first 8 characters are painted in the transcript.
Median of the per-key lag from the trusted keydown to the first frame whose composer text holds the key, with a missed key counted at 2,000 ms.
